PERSONAL_INFO.TITLE: About me...
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P1: I am Hergen Engelhardt and started my professional journey in the hotel industry before moving into customer service and sales. With my experience in logistics and purchasing, I have acquired a broad skill set.
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P2: Recently, I completed further training as a frontend developer and am now expanding my knowledge in the backend. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Firebase, Git, and Scrum.
PERSONAL_INFO.TEXT_P3: Besides my passion for IT, I volunteer with the local fire department and enjoy discovering new places, cultures, and culinary highlights while traveling.

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skills...
SKILLS.TEXT_P1: I develop modern web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, relying on TypeScript and Angular to create scalable and high-performance solutions. UX and design are important to me, so I enjoy working with Figma.
SKILLS.TEXT_P2: I integrate databases and hosting with Firebase, while Git ensures clean version control. Using Scrum and agile methodologies, I remain flexible and work efficiently in a team. Web development is constantly evolving – that's exactly what makes it so exciting for me! I love discovering new technologies and continuously expanding my knowledge.
SKILLS.TEXT_P3: If you are looking for a specific skill or want to discuss exciting projects – feel free to contact me! I look forward to further expanding my knowledge and tackling new challenges.
